title: Deft Chat
description: DeftChat is a feature-rich Minecraft chat plugin that connects your server with Discord. It offers beautiful chat formatting, multiple channels, and cross-server communication to enhance your server's community experience.
body:
# DeftChat

A powerful and feature-rich chat plugin for Minecraft servers that enhances communication between players and integrates seamlessly with Discord.

## Features

### 🎮 In-Game Chat
- Multiple chat channels (Local, Global, Staff, Admin)
- Beautiful gradient formatting support
- Role-based chat permissions
- Local chat with configurable range

### 💬 Discord Integration
- Real-time chat synchronization between Minecraft and Discord
- Customizable message formats
- Join/Leave notifications
- Support for multiple Discord channels

### 🎨 Advanced Formatting
- Gradient text support
- Role-based color schemes
- Customizable prefixes and suffixes
- Hex color support
- Configurable message formats

### 🔒 Security & Permissions
- Granular permission system
- Configurable color and gradient permissions
- Role-based access control


## Configuration

DeftChat is highly configurable through its `config.yml` file. You can customize:
- Discord bot settings
- Chat channel formats
- Message formatting
- Permission settings


## Support

If you need support with any of the plugins (bugs,issues,questions,etc)
Feel free to join our discord and make a ticket!
